description: An actor that can author changes in a Lix repository. Repository accounts carry durable attribution; optional public profile data is resolved separately through profile_uri.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable repository account identifier used for attribution. This is not an authentication credential or a public profile identifier.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Application-defined account category, such as a human, agent, application, or system actor.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Repository-local fallback display name used when profile_uri is absent or cannot be resolved. It is not authoritative and is not automatically synchronized with the public profile.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Application-defined lifecycle status of the account within this repository.

columns.name: profile_uri
columns.description: Optional absolute URI of a public machine-readable profile document. Profile data is presentation metadata and must not be used for authentication or authorization.
